race.description: Stanley River Thoroughbreds General Nediym Plate
race.comment: ICONIC SCENES (1) goes on top after making the perfect start at Eagle Farm over this trip when finishing best over SHE HAD A PLAN. Maloney sticks from a good draw and the pair can repeat the dose. Conversely SWIM UP BAR (2) was beaten a lip in his debut but was doing his best work late. Will likely settle back from his draw and be saved for the final shot at them SHE HAD A PLAN (6) deserves obvious respect after missing the bob. Expecting Jones to spear across from out there and take up the running. ALABAMA OUTLAW (3) looks the pick of the debutants and is drawn to get a nice tow into it, while ROSETTA BELLE (10) is another debutant that has shown encouraging signs in her lead-up work. Keeping a spot for them both in the exotics.
